description:
Run one server-side growth audit on a project (hosted POST /audit) over the last 30 days: where visitors drop between page view, CTA click, and signup, which page leaks the most CTA clicks, and which goal events stopped firing.

Free accounts: a successful call (status ok) uses the account's one free audit, for the life of the account. Ask the user before calling it on a free account, and pass cta_event when you know the real signup button event. A second successful audit needs Pro. Pro accounts can repeat it; each call is one metered read.

Not counted against the free audit: status no_data (the project has no events in the last 30 days, so the audit did not run), 400 validation errors, server errors, and 429 free_audit_in_progress (another audit for this account is still running; honour Retry-After).

cta_event and signup_event override detection. Without them, goal picking ranks event names by count, so a noisy CTA-like event (for example a generic cta_click on every nav link) can beat the real signup CTA. goals.cta_source says detected or request. Stopped events use a threshold of 3 firings, not 3 users, so one user firing a quiet event three times can be flagged; treat it as a prompt to check tracking, not proof it broke.

Hostname filter: when neither hostname nor exclude_hostnames is sent, the server excludes hosts whose names start with app. by default, so an app host such as app.example.com is left out of a landing-site audit. Pass exclude_hostnames as an empty list to include every host. Pass hostname as one host or a list to include only those hosts. The text prints a Traffic by hostname section (the top 5 hosts, each with page_view users and events when present) and the applied filter, for example Excluding app.* (default). filters echoes hostname, exclude_hostnames, and default_applied. When traffic is split across hosts, ask the user which hosts count as the landing site before you treat the audit as that site. Older hosted responses omit traffic_by_hostname and filters; the text then has no hostname section.

Returns findings as text plus structuredContent { type: "growth_audit", data } with goals, events, stopped_events, funnel, pages, leak, weakest_step, findings, caveats, free_audit, traffic_by_hostname, and filters.

Errors: 400 VALIDATION_ERROR, 403 PRO_REQUIRED with reason free_audit_used and a payment handoff (the free audit was already used; show the payment handoff to the user), 404 PROJECT_NOT_FOUND, 429 free_audit_in_progress with Retry-After, and 500 QUERY_FAILED.

cta_event.description: Event fired by the main signup CTA. Overrides detection, which ranks by count.

exclude_hostnames.description: Hosts to leave out. An empty list includes every host, including names starting with app. Omit both this and hostname to keep that default.

hostname.description: Include only these hosts. One hostname, or a list. Omit both this and exclude_hostnames to keep the server default, which excludes hosts starting with app.

signup_event.description: Event fired when an account is created. Overrides detection.

name: growth_audit
title: Growth audit
